philosophy.title: Beyond conventional
philosophy.lead: BMYGYM is an independent, founder-led creator and integrator of bespoke longevity environments.
philosophy.opening: Our starting point is the person, the architecture and the purpose of the space.
philosophy.body: We combine our own Signature Concepts with premium products and technologies selected from specialist manufacturers. This freedom allows every project to be considered individually, with the right solutions brought together as a coherent whole.
philosophy.collaboration: Alongside architects, interior designers, manufacturers and other expert partners, we develop the concept, curate its elements and coordinate integration within the agreed project scope.
philosophy.imageAlt: An integrated Pilates reformer in a calm private residence with a panoramic sea view

air.name: Air
air.imageAlt: AERO ONE concept: a transformable cream leather recovery chair inside a private aircraft, with extended leg support and integrated illuminated panels
air.subtitle: AERO ONE — Longevity above the clouds.
air.description: Our transformable recovery and longevity chair concept for private aviation explores a more personal experience of comfort, privacy and restoration in flight.
air.status: Concept in development. AERO ONE is not certified or commercially available. Its development and integration are subject to aircraft-specific technical feasibility, safety and aeronautical certification requirements.
air.detail: Conceived in dialogue with the cabin architecture, AERO ONE explores how a refined seating environment could transform into a dedicated space for personal recovery, with specialist aviation partners involved as the concept develops.

blueprint.title: Your vision.
blueprint.intro: Every exceptional environment begins with a clear understanding of the person, the architecture and the purpose of the space.
blueprint.name: BMYGYM Private Longevity Blueprint
blueprint.caption: A professional, paid commission
blueprint.description: The Private Longevity Blueprint is our first professional phase of conceptualisation and design: a tailored foundation for your movement, recovery and longevity environment.
blueprint.agreement: Design begins after a formal, paid commission is agreed. The scope, deliverables and fees are defined with you before this work starts.
scope: Initial selection of technologies and bespoke elements
Roadmap for the next project phases
blueprint.note: Deliverables are tailored to the agreed scope. Further design, product selection, manufacturing coordination and integration can be commissioned in subsequent phases according to the project’s needs.

approach.title: Every exceptional project
approach.imageAlt: An architectural concept model showing an integrated BMYGYM wellness environment on a yacht deck
approach.imageCaption: An exploration of space, material and possibility · Concept visualisation

stages.name: Discover
stages.copy: An initial conversation establishes your vision, the setting and the project’s requirements. We then agree the scope, deliverables and fees for your Private Longevity Blueprint.

stages.name: Conceive
stages.copy: Within the commissioned Blueprint, we develop the spatial strategy, concept and visual direction, bringing together architectural thinking, movement, recovery and longevity.

stages.name: Curate
stages.copy: In an agreed subsequent phase, we refine the selection of premium products, technologies, materials and specialist partners, alongside any appropriate Signature Concepts.

stages.name: Coordinate
stages.copy: According to the commissioned scope, we coordinate with architects, interior designers, specialist manufacturers and project teams to support fabrication and integration.
